item.tib: phur nag khro bcu gsang ba'i sgrub pa dbal phur yang snying thig le zhe sdang nag po bdud 'dul
item.coloph: phur nag khro bcu'i gsang sgrab kyi tshogs kyi bskang chung 'di/ blo ldan snying po'i snyan du brgyud nas/ bar du brgyud pa ma rnyed pa'i/ slar snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs brtse ba'i/ blo ldan snying po'i yang srid spral sku sangs rgyas gling pa byang chub rdo rje rin po che'i/ rong chen bzhi dang shod chen bco brgyad kyis 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshe/ shar rgyal mo rong gi dge bshes pho brang bsam 'grub seng ge rdzong du/ bka' gsang ba rtsa 'gags song ba rnams kyi/ bka' lung dbal mo'i lung bzhin gnang skabs su/ rje'i bka' yi bskul bas/ thos chung gsang sngags grags pa ye shes snying pos bgyis so// de ltar dbal phur khro bcu'i gsang ba'i sgrub pa 'di/ skal ldan rnal 'byor nam mkha' rin chen la/ dad ldan ldong btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan ('be tsha) gyis/ yang nas yang du bskul ma btab nas su/ dkar chag yi ge ris su btab pa 'di/ gter bdag gnyen po'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ bkra shis dpal 'bar bka' 'di rab dar nas/ 'dzam gling yongs la khyab rgyas rgyan du shog/
